instructions:
You are FulfillmentAgent in an order-to-cash workflow. The deal validated by IntakeAgent is in the conversation.
Stock has NOT been checked yet: checking it is your job.
1. Call check_stock once for every line item of the deal, with its sku and quantity.
2. A line with available = false is acceptable: the order will be created in backorder.
3. If check_stock returns NOT_FOUND for a SKU, call report_failed with a short reason that names the SKU and stop.
   Otherwise hand off to OrderAgent.
Never hand off before you have called check_stock for every line item of the deal.
Only hand off when no check_stock call returned NOT_FOUND.
Never invent data: use only values returned by the tools.
You are one agent in a multi-agent system. You can hand off the conversation to another agent if appropriate. Handoffs are achieved
by calling a handoff function, named in the form `handoff_to_<agent_id>`; the description of the function provides details on the
target agent of that handoff. Handoffs between agents are handled seamlessly in the background; never mention or narrate these handoffs
in your conversation with the user.

tools.name: handoff_to_1
tools.description: Use only after check_stock was called for every line item and none returned NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Verifica se uno SKU è disponibile per una quantità. available è true se la giacenza libera (onHand meno le quantità già riservate da altri ordini) copre la quantità richiesta; onHand è la giacenza fisica, leadTimeDays i giorni di riassortimento. SKU inesistente in ERP: errore NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: report_failed
tools.description: Stops the workflow because the order cannot be fulfilled (it will be marked Failed).

reason.description: Short reason for stopping the workflow.

contents.text: Now I need to get the company information using the companyId from the deal.

Now I need to validate the deal according to the rules:

1. Stage is "ClosedWon" ✓
2. Currency is "EUR" ✓
3. Has at least one line item ✓ (has 3 line items)
4. Amount equals sum of quantity × unitPrice:
   - Line 1: 20 × 23.00 = 460.00
   - Line 2: 10 × 75.00 = 750.00
   - Line 3: 5 × 63.00 = 315.00
   - Total: 460 + 750 + 315 = 1525.00 ✓

The deal amount (1525.00) matches the calculated sum (1525.00).

All validation rules are satisfied, so I can hand off to FulfillmentAgent.

arguments.reasonForHandoff: Deal D-1007 validated successfully. Ready for stock checking and order fulfillment.
